Desirable / Good to Have Starburst / Presto: Experience with Starburst Presto for federated query execution, data integration, and access governance. NoSQL / Alternate Data Sources: Exposure to MongoDB or big data repositories. Domain Knowledge: Functional understanding of AML / KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), and regulatory compliance metrics. Report Migration: Prior experience converting legacy reports or migrating reports between platforms Automation & Scripting: Familiarity with workload automation and scheduling tools (Autosys, Cron), Unix/Linux shell scripting, or Cognos Java SDK. Qualifications & Certifications Essential Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related quantitative discipline.
